title: username set without password silently skips auth
description: In both webdav_store.rs files, the auth header is only set when (Some(username), Some(pwd)) — both are present. If a user sets username without password (or password without username), no Authorization header is sent, but no error or warning is issued. The user believes they have configured auth when they have not; requests silently go unauthenticated, yielding confusing 401s or worse (if the server accepts anonymous access, data exposure). Fix: validate at config time that either both username+password are set or neither.
